louisville, ky  
dallas, tx  
tampa, fl

=====================================

**use your skills to make an impact**

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI & Agentic Architecture
description:
position type:

location(s):

united states, aliso viejo, ca

date posted:

job id:

r-125588

  

**why sony interactive entertainment?**

sony interactive entertainment isn’t just the best place to play — it’s also the best place to work. sony interactive entertainment (sie) is the company behind the playstation brand. as a subsidiary of sony group corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. sie is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (ip) in the world. our role at sie is to create and nurture the experiences under the playstation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**senior software engineer - ai & agentic architecture**
  
  
this is a senior individual-contributor role combining deep hands-on engineering with multiple agentic frameworks & sdks, harnesses, mcp, and apis, technical leadership, and close collaboration with engineering, security, and product teams. you'll design and ship agentic systems, developer tooling, and reusable platform capabilities that improve productivity across sie.

**what you'll do:**

***agentic & ai engineering***

* design, build, and operate production-quality agentic applications using agentic sdks/harnesses — including multi-agent orchestration, subagent delegation, tool integration, and lifecycle hooks.
* design model context protocol (mcp) tool and resource interfaces that give coding agents/harnesses safe, reliable access to backend systems and enterprise data.
* engineer prompts for reliable structured output (json schemas, few-shot examples, validation/retry loops) and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality.
* manage context effectively across long documents, multi-turn conversations, and multi-agent handoffs; design escalation and human-in-the-loop patterns for production reliability.

***developer productivity***

* configure and extend codex/claude code for team-wide use: agents.md/claude.md hierarchies, custom slash commands, agent skills, path-specific rules, and plan mode.
* integrate agentic development into ci/cd pipelines for automated code review, test generation, and pr feedback, tuned to minimize false positives and duplicate findings.
* build and maintain mcp server integrations (project- and user-scoped) that extend agent-native development capabilities across engineering workflows.
* identify high-value opportunities for ai-assisted development and design reusable capabilities that multiple teams can adopt, not just one-off solutions.

***discovery, prototyping & production delivery***

* partner directly with engineering teams to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities through hands-on discovery.
* rapidly prototype and validate new ai capabilities with real users, then take successful prototypes into secure, observable, maintainable production systems.
* own the full lifecycle: implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

***technical leadership***

* provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, and troubleshooting of agentic systems.
* mentor engineers on agentic design patterns, prompt engineering, and agent-native development practices.
* communicate tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and documentation that help other teams build effectively with agentic development tools.

**requirements**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on work building and operating ai/llm-powered or agentic applications.
* strong programming skills (java, python, go, rust, or c++) and solid engineering fundamentals — api design, testing, debugging, code review, maintainable code.
* practical, production-grade experience with agentic sdks/harnesses, mcp, and llms — tool use, orchestration, rag, context management, structured output, and evaluation.
* experience designing mcp tool/resource interfaces and reasoning about tool selection, error handling, and reliability in multi-agent systems.
* demonstrated experience integrating ai into ci/cd and developer workflows.
* ability to work in ambiguous problem spaces, evaluate tradeoffs, and make pragmatic engineering decisions.
* strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience mentoring and leading through influence.

**preferred qualifications**

* demonstrated expertise across agentic architecture, mcp integration, codex/claude code configuration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* experience building multi-agent research or customer support systems, or structured data extraction pipelines.
* experience with aws, docker, kubernetes, terraform, and gitops in support of ai/agentic infrastructure.
* familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and ai evaluation frameworks.
* contributions to open-source projects involving ai, agentic systems, or developer tooling.
* strong systems thinking — understands how models, agents, tools, context, apis, data, and infrastructure fit together as production systems, and can reason about dependencies and tradeoffs across the stack.
* a track record of adapting quickly to new ai tools, models, and frameworks as the space evolves.

in addition, this role is eligible for sie’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for sony products. this role also may be eligible for a bonus package.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**about care access**

care access is working to make the future of health better for all. **with hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** we are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.**

with programs like *future of medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *difference makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

to learn more about care access, visit www.careaccess.com.

### **how this role makes a difference**

by joining our team as a **senior machine learning engineer**, you will play a pivotal role in building cutting-edge ai products that directly impact how new therapies reach patients. we're looking for an experienced ml engineer who is passionate about turning advanced ai research into scalable, real-world solutions. you thrive on solving complex problems, pay close attention to detail, and consistently seek to automate and improve processes. you shine as a collaborator and excel as an individual contributor, with the courage to tackle challenging problems and the humility to learn and adapt. your initiative and discipline allow you to thrive while working remotely, and your high degree of empathy and communication skills makes you the kind of colleague everyone wants on their team. as an integral member of our fast-growing organization, you will leverage ai to transform clinical research and improve patient care.

### **how you'll make an impact**

* build and deploy ai-driven products that accelerate clinical trials and improve patient outcomes. your work will deliver scalable machine learning solutions to complex, real-world problems in clinical research.
* develop advanced ml models and llm-powered agents for critical use cases like patient recruitment, enrollment forecasting, and study feasibility. you'll also help expand our ai knowledge base architecture to support these innovative solutions.

**job description**

about the role

we are building a new ai function to modernize how our metals operations generate, connect, and act on data. the \*\*neural network architect\*\* will lead the design and implementation of a \*\*unified data and ai infrastructure\*\* that links our enterprise resource planning (erp), shop floor process/control systems (scada, plc, mes/historian data), laboratory information management systems (lims), cost accounting systems, and customer relationship management (crm) platforms into a single, coherent architecture.

this is a foundational, cross-functional role. the person in this seat will not just design neural network models, but they will architect the data backbone that makes reliable, production-grade ai possible across the enterprise: from predictive quality control and yield optimization on the shop floor, to demand forecasting that links crm and production data, to cost-to-serve models that tie financials to real-time operations.

scope:

while "neural network architect" is the title, this role is as much about systems integration, data engineering, and information architecture\*\* as it is about neural network design. candidates should be equally comfortable designing a data pipeline between a plc historian and an erp as they are designing or evaluating a deep learning model. we are not looking for a pure research scientist, rather we are looking for someone who can turn fragmented industrial data into an infrastructure that ai systems (including neural networks) can reliably run on.

key responsibilities

unified infrastructure design

* architect a scalable, secure data platform that integrates erp, shop floor/process control systems, lims, cost/financial systems, and crm into a shared data layer.
* define data models & schemes to link above data with data security and pathways for statistical models to be integrated
* establish real-time and batch data pipelines connecting operational technology (ot) systems on the shop floor with information technology (it) systems (erp, crm, finance).

neural network & ai model development

* design, train, and deploy neural network and other ml models on top of the unified data infrastructure for use cases such as predictive maintenance, quality/defect prediction, yield optimization, demand forecasting, and cost anomaly detection.
* evaluate where deep learning is the right tool versus simpler statistical or rules-based approaches, given industrial data constraints (sparsity, sensor noise, labeling challenges).
* build mlops practices for model versioning, monitoring, and retraining as plant and market conditions evolve.

systems integration & governance

* partner with it, ot/automation engineers, lab managers, finance, and sales operations to map data sources, ownership, and access rules across departments.
* establish data governance standards: data quality, lineage, security, and access control across sensitive systems (cost data, customer data, process parameters).
* select and implement integration tooling (apis, middleware, historians, data buses) appropriate for connecting legacy industrial systems with modern cloud/on-prem ai infrastructure.

leadership & strategy

* serve as the technical authority on how ai infrastructure should be built as the company's ai department scales.
* advise leadership on architecture trade-offs, build-vs-buy decisions, and sequencing of integration work (e.g., which systems to connect first for fastest roi).
* document architecture decisions and mentor future data engineers/ml engineers hired into the department.

## required qualifications

  

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, data engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, or related field (phd a plus but not required).
* 7+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or ml/ai engineering, including at least 3 years working with industrial or manufacturing data (ot/it integration experience strongly preferred).
* demonstrated experience designing and deploying neural networks or other ml models in production (not just research/prototype settings).
* hands-on experience integrating disparate enterprise systems â€” direct experience with erp platforms (sap, oracle, infor, etc.), mes/historian systems (e.g., osisoft pi, ignition, wonderware), and crm platforms (salesforce, dynamics, etc.) is highly valued.
* strong data engineering skills: sql, python, data pipeline tools (airflow, dbt, kafka, or similar), and cloud or on-prem data platforms (azure, aws, gcp, snowflake, databricks).
* working knowledge of ml/dl frameworks (pytorch, tensorflow) and mlops tooling.
* understanding of industrial control systems architecture (scada, plc, purdue model / isa-95 levels) and the security considerations of bridging ot and it networks.

## preferred qualifications

  

* prior experience in metals, mining, or heavy manufacturing industries.
* familiarity with lims platforms and quality/metallurgical data structures (chemistry, mechanical properties, heat treatment data).
* experience with cost accounting or erp-based financial data models (standard costing, activity-based costing).
* experience building a data/ai function from the ground up in a traditionally non-digital organization.
* knowledge of relevant industrial data standards (isa-95, mtconnect, opc ua).

success metrics for this role (first 18 months)

  

* a functioning, documented unified data architecture connecting at least erp + shop floor + lims as a first milestone, with crm and cost systems integrated in subsequent phases.
* at least one production ai/ml use case (e.g., a quality prediction or yield model) running on top of the new infrastructure.
* clear data governance and access framework adopted across departments.
* a scalable foundation that allows the ai department to add additional models and use cases without re-architecting from scratch.

*all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.*

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
the department of population and public health sciences at the university of southern california (usc) invites applications for an associate data scientist position supporting research in environmental health, exposomics, air pollution, and geospatial methods for modeling environmental and extreme weather-related exposures and their health impacts across the life course. this position offers opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and professional development, including co-authorship on publications, presentation at scientific conferences, and involvement in grant-funded research projects.

areas of scientific investigation include methods development around extreme weather and health, electronic medical record mining, large scale geospatial, remote sensing, and multimodal data integration and analysis, mobility and activity space analysis, and standardization of exposomics data pipelines. additional areas of interest may include the joint modeling of multiple exposures and interactions with community- and individual-level adaptation and resilience factors on health outcomes.

the successful candidate will use analytical, statistical, and programming skills to collect, analyze, and interpret large and complex data sets, and will assist with identifying data-analytic problems, determining the correct data sources, and developing solutions. individuals with strong technical skills in statistical programming, data modeling, and machine learning – particularly as applied to exposure science, geospatial analysis, remote sensing, or population health – will be given strong consideration. the ideal candidate is a well-rounded, detail-oriented individual who can work independently but also thrives in and contributes to interdisciplinary, collaborative team settings.

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
the department of population and public health sciences at the university of southern california (usc) invites applications for an associate data scientist position supporting research in environmental health, exposomics, air pollution, and geospatial methods for modeling environmental and extreme weather-related exposures and their health impacts across the life course. this position offers opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and professional development, including co-authorship on publications, presentation at scientific conferences, and involvement in grant-funded research projects.

areas of scientific investigation include methods development around extreme weather and health, electronic medical record mining, large scale geospatial, remote sensing, and multimodal data integration and analysis, mobility and activity space analysis, and standardization of exposomics data pipelines. additional areas of interest may include the joint modeling of multiple exposures and interactions with community- and individual-level adaptation and resilience factors on health outcomes.

the successful candidate will use analytical, statistical, and programming skills to collect, analyze, and interpret large and complex data sets, and will assist with identifying data-analytic problems, determining the correct data sources, and developing solutions. individuals with strong technical skills in statistical programming, data modeling, and machine learning – particularly as applied to exposure science, geospatial analysis, remote sensing, or population health – will be given strong consideration. the ideal candidate is a well-rounded, detail-oriented individual who can work independently but also thrives in and contributes to interdisciplinary, collaborative team settings.

responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* create, analyze and interpret large datasets to support research goals and solve data analytic problems

* knowledge of current data modeling tools and machine-learning techniques (e.g., clustering, decision-tree learning, artificial neural networks)

* demonstrated interest in data science and artificial intelligence; open-domain contributions (e.g., github) and/or published writing in data science are a plus

description:
here at siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. we do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! we know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. that’s why we always put our people first. our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. who knows where our shared journey will take you?

  

we’re building intelligent products that bring generative ai into the physical world. as a software engineer, you will play a central role in developing the platforms, apis, and systems that bring large language models and other generative technologies into real-world applications. our systems span the software-hardware boundary, combining low-latency inference pipelines, robust cloud infrastructure, and tightly integrated product experiences. you’ll work closely with engineers and research team and convert ideas to well functioning code.

this role blends product engineering with systems design and offers the opportunity to shape how users interact with ai, not just behind the scenes, but directly through the products they use.

**you’ll make an impact by:**

* design and build distributed services that are performant and maintainable
* own projects end-to-end, from design to deployment and monitoring
* collaborate with ml engineers, product managers, and infrastructure teams
* participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical deep dives
* contribute to team standards and continuously improve system reliability and performance

technologies we use  

* languages: python, go, typescript
* ml: pytorch, huggingface, onnx runtime, langchain
* infrastructure: aws, kubernetes, redis, postgres, s3, terraform
* devops & observability: github actions, datadog, grafana, prometheus

we do not expect deep experience with every tool, but we are looking for engineers who have repeatedly solved difficult problems at scale, and who know how to make good technical decisions under uncertainty.

**you will win us over by having the following qualifications:**

basic qualifications

* 3+ years of professional software development experience
* experience building and operating backend systems or distributed services
* proficiency in one or more programming languages such as python, go, or java
* strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design

preferred qualifications  

* experience working with machine learning pipelines or ai infrastructure
* familiarity with cloud-native systems (e.g. kubernetes, serverless, event-driven architectures)
* ability to take a problem from design through to production independently
* prior experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical efforts

**about the team:**

we are an early-stage engineering team solving hard technical problems at the intersection of ai, systems, and real-world interaction. we operate with high autonomy, collaborate closely across functions, and maintain high technical standards. software engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it.

**our commitment to equity and inclusion in our diverse global workforce:**

we value your unique identity and perspective. we are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. we welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

title: Data Analytics Analyst 4 4PC- 890
description:
**title: reporting support analyst** 
**client:** **southern company services** 
**location:** **atlanta, ga** 
**contract:** **5 months**
==========================================================================================================================================

**position summary**
====================

we are seeking a reporting support analyst to support enterprise reporting solutions developed through power bi. the ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with power bi, sql, and databricks to investigate reporting issues, validate data accuracy, troubleshoot refresh and access concerns, identify data-quality issues, and coordinate with technical teams to ensure timely resolution. strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills are essential

**key responsibilities** 
**production reporting support**
==========================================================

· serve as the first line of support for reporting incidents, data questions, access issues, and report usage inquiries. · monitor reporting operations and identify failures, delays, incomplete outputs, or service disruptions. · validate scheduled report execution, output availability, publication, and restoration following an incident. · escalate technical defects with a clear problem statement, business impact, evidence, and steps already completed. · confirm resolution through business validation, production verification, and documented closure criteria.

**databricks and data platform support**
----------------------------------------

· navigate databricks workspaces and use databricks sql to investigate data anomalies and reporting discrepancies. · trace data from source and ingestion through curated data products and reporting consumption layers. · validate transformations, business rules, filters, joins, aggregations, and source-to-target results. · review notebook, job, or pipeline results needed to determine whether an issue is caused by latency, failed processing, data quality, transformation logic, or downstream reporting. · use data lineage and catalog information, including unity catalog where applicable, to identify relevant tables, views, owners, and downstream dependencies. · partner with data engineering, cdp, and reporting development to support root-cause analysis, testing, release validation, and post-deployment monitoring.

**data investigation and report validation**
--------------------------------------------

· perform sql-based analysis, reconciliation, and expected-versus-actual validation. · determine whether an issue is related to source data, databricks processing, cdp, report logic, security, configuration, distribution, or user interpretation. · interpret report calculations, parameters, filters, and business rules. · document findings, supporting evidence, decisions, and recommended actions in a form usable by both business and technical teams.

**incident and service management**
-----------------------------------

· triage requests, assess operational and compliance impact, assign appropriate priority, and coordinate ownership. · organize response activities across analysts, developers, data engineers, platform teams, and business subject-matter experts. · provide concise, timely status updates that explain impact, current findings, ownership, next actions, and known workarounds. · participate in root-cause reviews and convert lessons learned into monitoring, documentation, or process improvements. · maintain complete and accurate ticket records through resolution and closure.

**business user and stakeholder support**
-----------------------------------------

· help users identify the appropriate report or data product for an operational need. · explain report behavior, calculations, data definitions, refresh timing, known limitations, and expected results in business-friendly language. · support training, adoption, and change communications for reporting solutions. · manage expectations professionally during incidents, competing priorities, and unresolved investigations.

**reporting platform and distribution support**
-----------------------------------------------

· support power bi reports, paginated reports, dashboards, refreshes, parameters, subscriptions, rendering, and basic access troubleshooting. · validate scheduled-job execution and coordinate recovery or rerun activities through established operating procedures. · support release readiness, production deployment validation, and stabilization monitoring.

**compliance, governance, and knowledge management**
----------------------------------------------------

· follow established sox 404 control procedures, evidence requirements, documentation standards, and escalation protocols. · support audit inquiries and maintain evidence demonstrating completed monitoring, validation, recovery, and control activities. · create and maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, report metadata, support procedures, and known-issue documentation. · promote cross-training, backup coverage, repeatable processes, and reduced dependence on individual subject-matter experts. · contribute to reporting standards, service metrics, trend analysis, and continuous improvement.

**required qualifications**
===========================

· bachelor's degree in information systems, data analytics, computer science, business analytics, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. · experience supporting business intelligence, reporting, data, analytics, or production operations in an enterprise environment. · hands-on experience writing and interpreting sql for investigation, validation, and reconciliation. · working experience with databricks or a comparable cloud data and analytics platform. · experience with power bi or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform. · demonstrated ability to communicate technical findings clearly to business and leadership audiences.

**required technical competencies**
===================================

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

· hands-on experience supporting power bi reports, dashboards, paginated reports, semantic models, refresh schedules, subscriptions, access, and production issue resolution. · experience validating report calculations, filters, parameters, data relationships, and source-to-report results to identify reporting defects and data discrepancies. · experience with microsoft fabric, data warehouses, enterprise semantic models, or related analytics platforms. · databricks sql, delta lake, data lineage, or lakehouse concepts. · autosys or comparable enterprise scheduling and job-monitoring experience. · remedy helix, servicenow, jira, or comparable ticketing and work-management experience. · sharepoint and enterprise knowledge-management experience. · experience supporting regulatory, financial, or sox-controlled reporting. · utility, customer operations, billing, payments, field operations, or other relevant business-process knowledge.

**behavioral competencies**
===========================

· ownership and accountability: drives issues through validation and closure rather than stopping at handoff. · analytical problem solving: uses evidence to isolate the problem and distinguish symptoms from root causes. · customer focus: supports users with patience, clarity, and appropriate urgency. · communication: tailors technical depth for business users, developers, data engineers, and leaders. · collaboration: works effectively across reporting, cdp, data engineering, compliance, and business teams. · adaptability: learns evolving data platforms, reports, business rules, and support processes. · risk awareness: recognizes operational, data-quality, security, and compliance implications and escalates appropriately. · knowledge sharing: documents repeatable solutions and actively builds team capability and backup coverage.

**measures of success**
=======================

· timely, accurate triage and resolution of reporting support requests. · high-quality incident records, investigation evidence, and stakeholder communications. · accurate identification of whether issues originate in source systems, cdp, reporting logic, security, configuration, distribution, or user interpretation. · reliable production validation following changes, reruns, fixes, and deployments. · reduction in repeat incidents through root-cause action, monitoring, and knowledge documentation. · consistent execution of compliance controls and evidence requirements. · improved organizational resiliency through cross-training, runbooks, and reduced key-person dependency. · trusted partnership with business customers and technical delivery teams.
  
  
**key skills**

**python | r | sql | data visualization | matplotlib | seaborn | tableau | data analysis | data integration | etl processes | data extraction | data transformation | data loading | database management | statistical analysis | hypothesis testing | machine learning | predictive modeling | data insights**

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**about care access**

care access is working to make the future of health better for all. **with hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** we are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.**

with programs like *future of medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *difference makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

to learn more about care access, visit www.careaccess.com.

### **how this role makes a difference**

as a **senior data scientist**, you will play a pivotal role in advancing reify health's data-driven solutions for clinical trials. in this position, you will drive the development of statistical models and machine learning algorithms to improve patient enrollment and trial management. you'll work in a highly regulated healthcare data environment, ensuring compliance with privacy standards while innovating on predictive analytics. this role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams (especially ml engineering) to translate complex data insights into practical, impactful tools for the clinical research community.

### **how you'll make an impact**

* site randomization forecasting: develop/enhance forecasting models for site randomization and enrollment trends, enabling better planning and resource allocation across trial sites.
* patient matching/ranking algorithms: support projects to build algorithms that intelligently match patients to (or rank patients for) appropriate clinical trials, enhancing recruitment efficiency and patient inclusion.
* develop other advanced statistical models: create and refine predictive models (bayesian inference, regression analysis, time-series forecasting) to address other key clinical trial challenges and improve decision-making.
* ai monitoring and bias detection: implement processes to monitor machine learning models in production, detecting bias or performance drift and ensuring models remain fair, accurate, and compliant.
* data pipeline & tooling development: build and optimize data pipelines and analytical workflows using tools like aws athena, redshift, sagemaker, and dbt, enabling scalable model training and deployment.
* regulatory compliance in data science: ensure all data science practices align with hipaa, gdpr, and other privacy regulations, integrating compliance considerations into model development and data handling.
* cross-functional collaboration: work closely with machine learning engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to integrate models into products and clearly communicate insights and recommendations.

### **the expertise required**

* statistical & ml expertise: strong foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, including experience with bayesian methods, regression analysis, and time-series forecasting.
* model monitoring & fairness: proficiency in evaluating model performance and bias, with the ability to implement ai monitoring tools and bias mitigation strategies to ensure ethical and reliable outcomes.
* technical toolset: advanced programming skills in python (with libraries such as scikit-learn, pymc, mlforecast, etc.) and sql, as well as familiarity with data transformation tools like dbt.
* cloud & data infrastructure: hands-on experience with cloud-based analytics and ml services, especially aws tools (athena for querying, redshift for data warehousing, sagemaker for model development/deployment).
* regulated data handling: experience working with sensitive healthcare or clinical trial data under regulations like hipaa and gdpr, demonstrating a deep commitment to data privacy and security best practices.
* collaborative communication: excellent teamwork and meticulous verbal/written communication abilities, with a track record of partnering with engineering and product teams to translate data science work into actionable business solutions.
* domain knowledge: understanding of clinical research or health-tech environments is highly valuable, including insight into clinical trial operations and a passion for improving patient outcomes through data.

### **certifications/licenses, education, and experience:**

* minimum education:
  + minimum of master's or ph.d. in statistics, data science, computer science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent professional experience).
* minimum experience:
  + minimum of 5+ years of hands-on data science or analytics experience, preferably in a healthcare, clinical research, or other highly regulated data environment.

### **how we work together**

* **location**: remote within the united states. this role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.
* **travel**: this is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.
* **physical demands associated with this position include**: the ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

the expected pay range for this role is $140,000 - $190,000 usd per year for full time team members.

### **benefits & perks (us full time employees)**

* paid time off (pto) and company paid holidays
* 100% employer paid medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options
* health savings account and flexible spending accounts
* bi-weekly hsa employer contribution
* company paid short-term disability and long-term disability
* 401(k) retirement plan, with company match

fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of ai products. we build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. for developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of ai-native products.

as generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

**about this role:**
--------------------

help fal's ml team move faster by building the automation, infrastructure, and developer tooling that makes developing, testing, and deploying generative ai models seamless.

you'll own and improve the ci/cd systems supporting our rapidly growing collection of ml models and inference pipelines. your focus will be on eliminating manual work, accelerating development cycles, and building reliable systems that allow ml engineers to ship new models and optimizations with confidence.

this is a high-impact engineering role where you'll work closely with our applied ml and ml performance teams. you'll build everything from automated model validation and performance benchmarking to ai-powered development workflows that help engineers iterate faster.

the ideal candidate thinks beyond traditional ci/cd and sees automation as a force multiplier for the entire engineering organization.

**what you’ll do:**

* own ml ci/cd infrastructure design, build, and maintain automated testing, validation, and deployment pipelines for our ml models and inference services.
* accelerate development cycles.dramatically reduce ci execution times through intelligent parallelization, caching, test selection, and efficient use of compute resources.
* build automated model validation.develop systems that test model outputs, detect quality regressions, and validate changes across different models, gpu architectures, and configurations.
* automate performance benchmarking. build continuous performance testing that detects regressions in inference latency, throughput, gpu utilization, and cost.
* build automated pricing and deployment checks. ensure model pricing, billing configurations, api schemas, and deployments are validated automatically before reaching production.
* extend our agentic engineering workflows. develop ai-powered automation and agentic coding systems that automatically diagnose ci failures, identify regressions, propose fixes, and streamline engineering workflows.
* improve deployment reliability. build automated safeguards, deployment verification, rollback mechanisms, and monitoring to ensure new model releases are reliable.
* eliminate engineering toil. identify repetitive tasks across the ml team and build tools and systems that automate them, allowing engineers to focus on developing new models and improving performance.

### **qualifications/nice-to-haves:**

* 5+ years of software engineering background with proficiency in python and experience building production infrastructure and developer tooling.
* experience designing and operating ci/cd systems using github actions or comparable technologies.
* deep understanding of automated testing, build systems, dependency management, caching, and parallel execution.
* experience working with containerized workloads, docker, and cloud infrastructure.
* ability to design reliable distributed systems and debug complex infrastructure failures.
* strong understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, tracing, and automated alerting.
* a passion for developer productivity and a demonstrated ability to eliminate manual processes through automation.
* comfortable working independently, identifying high-impact problems, and building end-to-end solutions.

* experience with ml infrastructure, pytorch, gpu workloads, or model-serving systems.
* familiarity with nvidia gpu architectures and multi-gpu environments.
* experience building automated inference benchmarks or ml quality evaluation frameworks.
* experience with agentic coding tools such as codex or claude code, or building custom ai engineering agents.
* experience optimizing ci/cd pipelines at scale, including distributed test execution and ephemeral compute environments.
* experience developing internal developer platforms or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

**tech stack:**

* python, pytorch, docker, github actions
* nvidia gpus and distributed gpu infrastructure
* model serving and inference pipelines
* observability and performance monitoring tools
* ai coding agents and automated engineering workflows
* access to fal's massive gpu cluster for testing and development

bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field (e.g., computer science, biomedical engineering, software engineering). medical device or regulated industry experience is a plus.

professional growth and development opportunities.

we are seeking a talented, entrepreneurial software engineer to join clm ai as an early member of our founding technology team, working remotely from new york city.

this is an opportunity to help develop the technical foundations of an ambitious ai-powered media platform as it moves from mvp development towards commercial launch.

working directly with the founder & ceo, the successful candidate will help evolve our existing web and app products, integrate ai technologies, build scalable software infrastructure and develop new features that bring our creator and digital personality ecosystem to life.

the successful candidate will be comfortable operating in an early-stage environment, taking ownership of technical challenges and translating product ideas into reliable, production-ready software.

we are looking for someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with curiosity, commercial awareness and a genuine interest in the future of ai.

3. key responsibilities

**software engineering & product development**

* develop, maintain and improve clm ai's web applications, mobile experiences and supporting software infrastructure.
* translate product requirements and business objectives into technical specifications and working software.
* build reliable, secure, maintainable and scalable application features.
* improve the existing mvp and support the transition towards a commercially viable product.

**ai integration & digital experiences**

* integrate third-party ai models, apis and services into clm ai's platform.
* support the development of ai-powered digital personalities, creator avatars and interactive user experiences.
* help integrate conversational ai, voice technologies, multimedia capabilities and personalised content experiences.
* build the software interfaces and backend services required to connect ai capabilities with user-facing products.
* work with the ai engineer to turn ai prototypes into dependable product features.

**backend, apis & infrastructure**

* develop and maintain backend services, apis, databases and authentication systems.
* design integrations with external platforms, creator tools and content services.
* support cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, monitoring and application performance.
* implement appropriate data protection, access controls and security practices.
* design systems with future user growth, subscription revenue and international expansion in mind.

**quality, security & reliability**

* write clean, testable and well-documented code.
* develop automated tests and participate in code reviews.
* identify and resolve bugs, performance issues and technical bottlenecks.
* apply secure software development practices and help protect user information.
* contribute to technical documentation and establish sound engineering standards from an early stage.

**product strategy & team collaboration**

* participate in technical planning, product prioritisation and architecture decisions.
* identify opportunities to improve development speed, product quality and operational efficiency.
* communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* help establish clm ai's engineering culture, development processes and long-term technical foundations.

4. essential skills & experience

* professional experience developing and shipping software applications.
* strong proficiency in a modern programming language such as typescript, javascript, python, java, go or an equivalent.
* experience with modern frontend frameworks, preferably react or next.js.
* experience developing backend services, rest apis or equivalent application interfaces.
* practical experience with relational databases and data modelling, such as postgresql.
* understanding of cloud hosting, deployment, version control and ci/cd workflows.
* familiarity with software testing, debugging, application security and performance optimisation.
* ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage competing priorities.
* strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and clear communication.
* a portfolio of shipped products, projects or demonstrable engineering work.

5. desirable skills & experience

* experience building ai-enabled applications or integrating large language model apis.
* familiarity with ai agent frameworks, conversational interfaces or generative media tools.
* experience with voice, video, avatar or multimedia integrations.
* knowledge of subscription platforms, payment processing and user account management.
* experience with cloud platforms such as aws, google cloud or microsoft azure.
* familiarity with mobile application development or cross-platform technologies.
* experience building consumer applications with strong user engagement.
* previous experience in a startup, scale-up, creator economy, entertainment or media technology business.
* experience designing systems for high availability, privacy and future scalability.

6. technology environment

the precise stack will be agreed with the successful candidate based on clm ai's existing mvp, current infrastructure and product roadmap.

potential technologies include:

* **frontend:** react, next.js, typescript.
* **backend:** node.js, python and api-based services.
* **databases:** postgresql and appropriate caching or storage services.
* **ai integrations:** llm apis, conversational ai, voice and generative media services.
* **infrastructure:** aws, google cloud or equivalent cloud platforms.
* **engineering tools:** github, automated testing, ci/cd and application monitoring.
* **payments and subscriptions:** integration with suitable subscription and payment providers.

candidates should be able to assess existing technology, recommend appropriate improvements and avoid unnecessary complexity or infrastructure costs during the early stages of development.

7. what success looks like

**first 30 days**

* understand clm ai's vision, existing mvp, architecture and technical priorities.
* review the existing codebase and identify critical technical improvements.
* agree on an initial development roadmap with the founder & ceo.
* establish a clear understanding of development workflows, responsibilities and delivery milestones.

**first 60 days**

* begin delivering prioritised product improvements and new functionality.
* implement or improve key backend services and ai integrations.
* address significant reliability, security, testing or performance issues.
* establish a consistent development and reporting process.

**first 90 days**

* deliver measurable improvements to product functionality and technical quality.
* support progress towards a launch-ready, commercially viable platform.
* document the architecture, deployment processes and key technical decisions.
* establish a realistic plan for subsequent development, testing and scaling.

success will be measured against agreed deliverables, product quality, reliability, collaboration and progress towards the launch roadmap.

8. candidate profile

we are looking for an engineer who wants to help build something meaningful, rather than simply complete tickets.

you should be curious about ai, commercially minded and comfortable working closely with a founder. you should enjoy solving problems, challenging assumptions constructively and making pragmatic technical decisions.

you do not need to have worked in a large technology company. demonstrable engineering ability, sound judgement, ownership and the capacity to deliver are more important than an impressive job title.

experience with ai and creator technology is advantageous, but a strong software engineering foundation and the ability to learn quickly are essential.

9. location & working arrangements

equity or other long-term incentives may be considered where appropriate, subject to agreement and formal documentation. no equity award is implied by this specification.

the role's start date and engagement terms will be confirmed following recruitment and funding approval.

**ai engineer, (grade 8/7/6):**

**role summary**  
we are seeking a hands-on ai engineer with deep, daily experience using and extending ai coding agents to support a large-scale ai-enabled software engineering transformation within a leading financial services organization. this role is about building and shipping: using claude code, codex, cursor, and similar tools to deliver production code, and engineering the configurations, integrations, and automation that make those agents effective on enterprise codebases. the successful candidate will work in an ecosystem built on claude (including claude code and claude on aws bedrock), openai codex, cursor, and aws.  
  
should be familiar with coding agents- claude, codex and tools like cursors etc.  
  
**key responsibilities**  
*hands-on delivery with coding agents*

* use coding agents (claude code, codex, cursor, github copilot, and similar) daily to deliver production-quality code: features, refactors, migrations, tests, and documentation.
* apply agents to legacy modernization, code migration, and platform migration work on large, multi-repo enterprise codebases.
* serve as the reference implementer: prove out patterns on real projects, then codify them for other teams.
* review, test, and harden agent-generated code to production standards.

***agent configuration & customization (build)***

* build and maintain standardized agent configurations: project memory files (claude.md, agents.md, cursor rules), custom slash commands, skills, subagents, and hooks.
* develop mcp servers and tool integrations connecting agents to internal systems (repos, ticketing, ci/cd, documentation, internal apis).
* engineer context packages, prompt templates, and codebase indexing approaches tailored to large and legacy environments.
* tune agent behavior and diagnose failure modes such as context overflow, tool misuse, and looping.

***agent-driven sdlc automation***

* build headless and background agent workflows using clis and sdks (claude code headless mode, claude agent sdk, codex cli).
* implement agent automation in ci/cd pipelines: automated pr review, test generation, dependency upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and migration jobs.
* build internal tooling and wrappers that make agents easy and safe to run across repos and teams.
* automate the measurement and evaluation of agent output quality, including tests and regression checks on agent-generated changes.

***security, governance & guardrails (implementation)***

* implement technical controls for safe agent usage: permission models, sandboxing, command allowlists, secrets handling, and data-exposure protections.
* integrate agents with governed claude access through aws bedrock, iam, and the enterprise ai gateway.
* build audit logging and usage tracking for agent activity and ai-generated code.
* partner with infosec, risk, and compliance to translate financial services regulatory and model risk requirements into enforceable technical controls.

***telemetry, evaluation & tool benchmarking***

* build telemetry pipelines and dashboards for usage, token consumption, cost, and quality metrics (acceptance rates, cycle time, defect rates).
* run hands-on bake-offs of emerging coding agents and models against real enterprise tasks; produce data-driven recommendations.
* stay current on rapidly evolving agentic coding tools and bring working prototypes, not slideware.

***knowledge sharing (secondary)***

* document reference implementations, and pair with engineering teams to unblock adoption.
* contribute reusable configs, templates, and examples to a shared internal repository.

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in python and at least one additional language (e.g., typescript, java).
* proven, daily hands-on use of claude code, codex, and cursor or similar agents to deliver production code, with examples of non-trivial work shipped.
* experience building mcp servers, custom tools, skills, subagents, or hooks.
* strong grasp of context and prompt design, task decomposition, and how to steer and verify agent output.
* experience building ci/cd automation and scripting agent workflows via clis or sdks.
* solid grounding in git workflows, testing, code review, and secure coding practices.
* working knowledge of aws (bedrock, iam, lambda, api gateway, s3).
* excellent analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with the claude agent sdk, claude on bedrock, or the openai agents sdk.
* experience applying coding agents to large-scale legacy modernization or migration programs.
* experience building internal developer platforms or developer productivity tooling.
* experience with ai gateways, llm observability, and usage/cost tracking.
* experience deploying ai coding tools in a regulated environment.
* familiarity with sast/dast and software supply chain security.
* infrastructure as code experience (terraform, cdk).
* financial services domain experience across banking, capital markets, asset management, wealth management, or insurance.
* aws certifications (developer, solutions architect, or machine learning

we are seeking a hands-on, production-focused applied machine learning engineer to take technical ownership of the model layer powering our next-generation generative media platform. in this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge generative research and scalable, consumer-facing products.

you will split your time between extending sota open-source models with additional capabilities and helping maintain our fleet of generative model apis.
  
**what you’ll do:**

* novel model pipelines: work with our post-training team to extend sota image, video, audio, and 3d models with additional capabilities and modalities. develop novel approaches to model conditioning, generation, and editing, including both training-free methods and model fine-tuning.
* fine-tuning: leverage our massive gpu fleet to fine-tune generative models for novel capabilities. build and maintain fine-tuning apis that allow customers to customize models for their specific needs.
* architecture & abstraction: identify common patterns across the models we serve and develop reusable components, abstractions, and building blocks that accelerate the development of new model capabilities and inference pipelines.
* inference optimization: work hand-in-hand with our ml performance & optimization team to apply state-of-the-art inference techniques and best practices, ensuring models run efficiently with low latency, high throughput, and optimal gpu utilization.
* production deployment: build, deploy, and maintain scalable, reliable generative model apis. anticipate and resolve production challenges to ensure our models serve customers reliably at scale.
* customer collaboration: work directly with customers, including some of the world's largest e-commerce retailers and film and tv production studios, to develop novel solutions to their generative media needs.

**qualifications/nice-to-haves:**

* experience: 3+ years of professional experience as an applied ml engineer, with at least 1–2 years focused on generative media or computer vision.
* core frameworks: expert-level proficiency in python and pytorch.
* generative media: deep practical understanding of diffusion and flow-based generative models.
* open-source tooling: hands-on experience working with open-weight model ecosystems, including hugging face, diffusers, and related tooling.
* engineering rigor: ability to anticipate and solve challenges that arise when deploying ml models to production. strong engineering judgment in designing systems that are scalable, reliable, secure, safe, and performant.

* training-free model extensions: experience designing and implementing training-free extensions to image, video, audio, or 3d generative models, such as novel conditioning methods, inference-time modifications, or new model capabilities.
* model post-training: experience developing and executing custom post-training or fine-tuning approaches to extend generative models with additional capabilities.
* startup experience: track record of working in fast-paced startup environments or digital media and entertainment industries.
* ability to ship: demonstrated ability to independently take ambitious ml ideas from concept to production.

**what we offer at fal:**

* interesting and challenging work
* a lot of learning and growth opportunities
* health, dental, and vision insurance (us)
* regular team events and offsites

title: Data Engineer
description:
**at associated electric cooperative, we're committed to providing reliable energy to the communities we serve with passion and precision. we're a tight-knit team dedicated to keeping the lights on and the energy flowing smoothly across our expansive network!**

**from technical to operational to professional disciplines, our team brings a wide variety of skills, talents, and expertise to the table. we believe in both dedicating ourselves to excellence and investing in your growth.**

be part of building the tech that maintains the largest machine on earth—the u.s. power grid. associated electric owns and operates a fleet of power plants powering homes across the midwest, and we’re building a new product that will become the backbone of how associated electric cooperative manages those power plants. this product will become the digital twin of our entire power plant fleet — used across the organization, from the plant floor to company leadership — giving everyone a shared, data-driven view of plant health and performance. it will unite asset data, financials, and strategic plans into one integrated platform that aligns daily operations with long-term strategy.

to build this product, we need you — an engineer with deep data and modeling experience — on our plant asset management technology team. you’ll join us on the ground floor of this new technology movement, shape the product, and work side-by-side with business stakeholders and software engineers to create something that matters. this will be a product that changes the game for its users, drives bottom-line impact for the company, and stands as a lighthouse example for the industry on how to make technology transform how we manage some of the most complex and critical assets in existence.

you and your team won’t be starting from scratch — the team already has full product management ownership of an ecosystem of power production technology systems that will integrate with this new product. some are third-party systems, like our newly modernized enterprise asset management platform, and others are smaller 3rd or first-party tools that may be modernized or replaced as the new product the team is building comes online. being part of supporting and evolving this ecosystem means that you’ll have ample opportunity to know your users, run and improve the current systems, and chart the future for each product in a world where the digital twin becomes the hub of plant management.

**what you’ll do:**

* **own the data design:** architect lakehouse models and pipelines that bring together telemetry from thousands of sensors and devices with work management and financial data. build the data mart and semantic model that power user-driven analytics.
* **build the digital twin:** design the high-level models that integrate asset-level predictive models with financial, work management, and operational data to create a true fleet-wide picture of health, risk, and performance. work with business teams managing asset models to ensure they can connect seamlessly into the digital twin.
* **fuse the enterprise:** integrate financial perspectives into reliability and lifecycle models, continually find ways to bring in additional operational, planning, and maintenance systems to enrich the digital twin.
* **build for the users:** champion the people who rely on this product — from plant floor staff to executives. relentlessly look for better ways to capture, model, and deliver insights, and connect them to the information they need to make faster, smarter decisions.
* **ship! ship! ship!** work with pm, ux, software engineers, and expert stakeholders to turn data, models, and visuals into a web app that users can’t wait to adopt. champion design, value, and quality so every release makes the product stronger.

**how we build:**

you’ll work in a small, empowered agile product team with a dedicated product manager (your direct lead), ux designer, software engineers, and analysts — shipping fast, learning fast, and building toward a bigger vision. you’ll collaborate daily to turn data and models into a web-based product that delights users, while iterating closely with plant staff and executives to ensure it works in the real world. you’ll build on a cloud-first microsoft stack — azure, databricks (delta lake), azure sql, cosmos db, azure web apps, python/c#. importantly, you’ll have leadership support and a mandate to deliver something that makes a lasting difference.

**what you’ll need:**

* **education & core skills:** a bachelor’s degree in a stem field (or equivalent experience) with a strong foundation in data engineering, system design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* **modern data engineering expertise:** proficiency with etl/elt frameworks, sql/nosql, and cloud-based data platforms — especially microsoft azure (storage accounts, sql databases, synapse analytics, data factory, data lake, delta lake).
* **data architecture:** deep understanding of how to design data architectures that power analytics and data science operations — including data modeling, star schemas, semantic layers, and decoupled system integration patterns that scale across the enterprise and support ml/ai workloads.
* **model engineering:** build and evolve the high-level databricks models that power the digital twin, combining financial, operational, and reliability data. support business teams by integrating their asset-level models into fleet-wide views and ensuring they connect seamlessly into the larger platform.
* **data visualization mastery:** ability to design visualizations for clarity and density, building visual dashboards, charts, and tools that expert users can quickly and capably use to see insights and perform deep analytics. familiarity with best practices (e.g., stephen few’s work) is a big plus.
* **programming & automation:** comfort with scripting or programming (python or similar) to automate pipelines and integrate with downstream systems — bonus points if you can speak the language of software engineers and help guide how data integrates into the ui.
* **business mindset:** ability to understand business processes, see the “why” behind requirements, and shape solutions that improve how the business runs — connecting technical decisions to business value.
* **collaboration & influence:** excellent communication skills, able to navigate technical and business discussions, align diverse teams, and lead initiatives without formal authority.

**what associated provides:**

* we are committed to rewarding talent with top pay. your efforts will be recognized with a total compensation package that reflects your experience and contributions.
* plan for your future with confidence! we offer a robust 401(k) program with a generous employer match to help you build the financial future you deserve.
* we know how important work-life integration is. recharge with pto and enjoy paid holidays, ensuring you have time to unwind and pursue your passions outside of work.
* your health matters to us! stay covered beginning on your first day of employment with our premier healthcare plan that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family.

**at associated electric cooperative, all of our 700+ employees across mo/ar/ok territory play a crucial role in powering our mission! whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find endless opportunities for career development here. join us in an environment where your contribution is valued, and your career can thrive as we work together to keep the lights on!**

title: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
**sophisticated work. in a great city. making a difference.**

the state of wisconsin investment board (swib) manages more than $178 billion in assets, including those of the fully-funded wisconsin retirement system (wrs). swib operates at a level more often seen in top-tier global asset managers than in typical public pension funds. swib is a home for top talent. approximately 61 percent of swib’s investment professionals are chartered financial analyst (cfa) charterholders.
  
  
the city of madison, the state capitol and home of wisconsin’s flagship university, makes regular appearances on lists of best places to live, eat, and play. swib offers a modern workspace, hybrid work options, and competitive compensation and benefits.

serving over 703,000 wrs beneficiaries, swib is driven by a clear mission: securing the financial future of those who serve wisconsin. when you work at swib, you know your work matters.

**job description:**

  

***\*applicants on an opt, cpt visa or anyone requiring h-1b transfers or sponsorship into the h-1b lottery will not be considered for this position.***

**essential activities:**

* design and develop impactful and insightful reports using power bi. ensure reports are accurate, performant, visually effective, intuitive, and aligned with business objectives and organizational standards.

* provide technical guidance on architecture, data modeling, dax development, sql, visualization standards, performance optimization, testing, and deployment practices.
